text_en: O give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 请你们向上主赞颂， 因为他是美善宽仁， 他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, those he redeemed from trouble
text_cn: 歌咏此曲的人们是： 上主亲身所救赎的， 由敌人手中救出的，

text_en: and gathered in from the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
text_cn: 从各地召集来的， 东西南北聚来的。

text_en: Some wandered in desert wastes, finding no way to an inhabited town;
text_cn: 他们在旷野和沙漠中漂流， 找不到往安居之城的道路。

text_en: hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted within them.
text_cn: 他们口渴而又腹饥， 生命已经奄奄一息；

text_en: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress;
text_cn: 他们于急难中一哀求上主， 上主即拯救他们脱离困苦，

text_en: he led them by a straight way, until they reached an inhabited town.
text_cn: 引领他们走入正道， 走入可安居的城廓。

text_en: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.
text_cn: 愿他们感谢上主的仁慈， 称颂他给人子显的奇迹。

text_en: For he satisfies the thirsty, and the hungry he fills with good things.
text_cn: 因为他使饥渴的人得到饱饫， 他使肚饿的人享尽美物。

text_en: Some sat in darkness and in gloom, prisoners in misery and in irons,
text_cn: 他们坐在黑暗与死影里， 尽为痛苦与铁链所缚系，

text_en: for they had rebelled against the words of God, and spurned the counsel of the Most High.
text_cn: 因为背弃了天主的命令， 又轻视了至高者的叮咛。

text_en: Their hearts were bowed down with hard labor; they fell down, with no one to help.
text_cn: 因此，他以苦难折磨了他们的心神， 他们跌倒了，却没有人来扶持他们。

text_en: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress;
text_cn: 他们于急难中一哀求上主， 上主即拯救他们脱离困苦，

text_en: he brought them out of darkness and gloom, and broke their bonds asunder.
text_cn: 领他们摆脱死影与黑暗， 把他们的铐镣完全弄断。

text_en: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.
text_cn: 愿他们感谢上主的仁慈， 称颂他给人子显的奇迹。

text_en: For he shatters the doors of bronze, and cuts in two the bars of iron.
text_cn: 因为他把铜门摧毁， 又把铁闩击碎。

text_en: Some were sick through their sinful ways, and because of their iniquities endured affliction;
text_cn: 他们因行为邪恶而病重， 因犯罪而遭受苦痛；

text_en: they loathed any kind of food, and they drew near to the gates of death.
text_cn: 他们厌弃各样的食物， 快已接近死亡的门户。

text_en: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress;
text_cn: 他们于急难中一哀求上主， 上主即拯救他们脱离困苦。

text_en: he sent out his word and healed them, and delivered them from destruction.
text_cn: 主发一言就将他们病除， 且拯救他们脱离了阴府。

text_en: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.
text_cn: 愿他们感谢上主的仁慈， 称颂他给人子显的奇迹。

text_en: And let them offer thanksgiving sacrifices, and tell of his deeds with songs of joy.
text_cn: 愿他们献上感恩的祭献， 将他的工程欢乐地宣传。

text_en: Some went down to the sea in ships, doing business on the mighty waters;
text_cn: 他们乘船，下海行航， 在大洋中往来经商，

text_en: they saw the deeds of the Lord , his wondrous works in the deep.
text_cn: 他们看见过上主的奇异作为， 遇到过他行于汪洋中的奇迹：

text_en: For he commanded and raised the stormy wind, which lifted up the waves of the sea.
text_cn: 他一发命，风浪狂掀， 海中波涛顿时高翻，

text_en: They mounted up to heaven, they went down to the depths; their courage melted away in their calamity;
text_cn: 时而忽跃冲天，时而忽坠深渊， 处此危急之中，他们胆战心寒，

text_en: they reeled and staggered like drunkards, and were at their wits’ end.
text_cn: 恍惚且晕眩，有如醉汉， 一切的经验，全部紊乱。

text_en: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he brought them out from their distress;
text_cn: 他们于急难中一哀求上主， 上主即拯救他们脱离困苦。

text_en: he made the storm be still, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
text_cn: 他化风暴为平静， 海涛顿时便安定；

text_en: Then they were glad because they had quiet, and he brought them to their desired haven.
text_cn: 他使风平浪静，大家个个欢忭（biàn）， 他领他们登上了渴望的海岸。

text_en: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.
text_cn: 愿他们感谢上主的仁慈， 称颂他给人子显的奇迹，

text_en: Let them extol him in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
text_cn: 在人民的集会中颂扬他， 在长老的议席上赞美他。

text_en: He turns rivers into a desert, springs of water into thirsty ground,
text_cn: 上主使河域变为荒滩， 使清水泉源变成干川，

text_en: a fruitful land into a salty waste, because of the wickedness of its inhabitants.
text_cn: 使肥沃土地变为咸田， 都因当地居民的罪愆。

text_en: He turns a desert into pools of water, a parched land into springs of water.
text_cn: 他又能使沙漠变成水源， 使旱地变成水泉。

text_en: And there he lets the hungry live, and they establish a town to live in;
text_cn: 把饥饿的人徙置在那地， 使他们兴建安居的城邑；

text_en: they sow fields, and plant vineyards, and get a fruitful yield.
text_cn: 耕田种地，开辟了葡萄园， 因此收获果实，丰富出产。

text_en: By his blessing they multiply greatly, and he does not let their cattle decrease.
text_cn: 上主祝福了他们人口繁衍， 赏赐他们的牲畜有增无减。

text_en: When they are diminished and brought low through oppression, trouble, and sorrow,
text_cn: 其后因惨遭灾患苦难， 人口减少而被弃如前。

text_en: he pours contempt on princes and makes them wander in trackless wastes;
text_cn: 但上主却使权贵遭受耻辱， 任他们徊徘歧途无路可走。

text_en: but he raises up the needy out of distress, and makes their families like flocks.
text_cn: 但拯救贫穷人脱离灾难， 使他家属多如羊群一般。

text_en: The upright see it and are glad; and all wickedness stops its mouth.
text_cn: 正直的人见到必然欢忭， 但邪恶的人却哑口无言。

text_en: Let those who are wise give heed to these things, and consider the steadfast love of the Lord .
text_cn: 那一位贤哲，详察此事， 并能体会上主的仁慈！
